name: AgentsPodium
description: AgentsPodium runs personal AI agents around the clock, each on its own pod with its own memory and files, answering in the owner's messenger. It hosts ready-made personas and open-source agent platforms (Hermes, OpenClaw, n8n, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi) on plans priced in dollars; the model key is the customer's own. The same service is driven by agents through an HTTP API, an MCP server and an A2A agent.

services.name: Managed hosting of open-source AI agent platforms
